verdict.rationale: Built-in utility apps are a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions Calendar, Weather, Maps, or Clock apps. It only names other built-in apps (Messages, Music, Reminders, Phone, Passwords, Safari), which are adjacent features and do not show the named utilities ship out of the box.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can rely on built-in utilities like calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps out of the box
